title: Improve Mouse Without Borders pairing error logging

proposed_comments.title: Preserve exception metadata in pairing logs

confidence.rationale: The pinned catch block passes only an interpolated string to Logger.LogError; the exception-aware alternative is directly actionable.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the exception as structured logging data

**Severity:** `medium`

Interpolating `ex` sends its rendered text as the message rather than the exception object, so log consumers cannot treat it as an exception field. Please use the exception-aware `Logger.LogError` overload with `ex` as its exception argument and keep the existing message; this preserves structured exception metadata for diagnosis.
